fieldData.description: Celebrate our 21st Annual Senoia Car Show with us on Saturday, September 26th, 2026! Collectible T-shirts this year are available in sizes SM-3XL and in the color China Blue! Shirts are a unisex cut
fieldData.special-notes: Sizes SM-3XL available online, if sizes 4XL are needed, please email welcome@enjoysenoia.com
fieldData.name: 21st Annual Senoia Car Show T-Shirts

fieldData.description: Celebrate our 21st Annual Senoia Car Show with us on Saturday, September 26th in Senoia! 600+ show cars fill the streets of Senoia. Enjoy this years collectible t-shirt available in sizes SM-3XL in the color China Blue!
fieldData.name: 21st Annual Senoia Car Show T-Shirt

fieldData.description: Celebrate America 250 with a patriotic Freedom Walk & Revere Run 5K! Our July 4th festivities will kick off with a 5K run at 8:00am, followed by a 2.5 mile walk at 8:30am. Bring your family, friends, and patriotic spirit to Downtown Senoia and help us encourage our runners & walkers! T-shirts are a unisex cut and available in the color Vintage White!
fieldData.name: Freedom Walk & Revere Run 5K T-Shirt

fieldData.description: Anniversary Logo Shirt: Celebrate our 20th Anniversary with this exculsive logo shirt! Adult sizes small through 3XL. Printed on Comfort Colors Pepper gray and White, it's perfect for fans of all ages. Shirts are $20.
fieldData.name: 20th Anniversary Logo T-Shirt

fieldData.description: 2025 Car Show Shirt: Join us for the 2025 Car Show with our Comfort Colors Ice Blue Shirt! Made from soft, breathable fabric, it features a vibrant design perfect for car lovers. Available in sizes small through 3XL. Shirts are $20 each.

fieldData.description: Join in on the Fat Tuesday fun with these custom t-shirts! Get ready to groove to soulful tunes and dance the night away! T-shirts are available in a women's v-neck cut and a men's crewneck tee featuring our Fat Tuesday logo on the front side. T-shirts are available in sizes small-3XL and fit true to size.
fieldData.name: Fat Tuesday Shirts

fieldData.description: Want to get your PorchFest on? Senoia PorchFest 2024 T-shirts are available for pre-order now. Shirts are $20 each! fieldData.description: Tickets for the Senoia 2nd Annual Mardi Gras Pub Crawl and Poker Run! Includes collectable t-shirt. Pub Crawl participants will check-in and pick up their t-shirt and wrist band starting at 6 p.m at Senoia Beer Co, 1 Main Street in downtown Senoia.
fieldData.additional-information:
You must complete your purchase of tickets and t-shirt by February 10th, 2023 to order your selection of style and size t-shirt.

All orders placed after February 10th will receive a men's large t-shirt at event check-in.

For clarity - T-shirts WILL NOT be shipped - you will pick up shirts your order when checking in at 6 p.m at Senoia Beer Co.

fieldData.description: Tour Hours are 4 p.m. - 7 p.m. on Sunday, December 11th, 2022. You may also pick up ticket booklets through December 11th at Boots-N-Bling located on Main Street. Their business hours are: Monday-Thursday: 10 a.m. - 5 p.m. - Friday & Saturday: 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. - Sunday: 1 p.m.- 5 p.m. Tickets can also be purchased at Table Talk at Senoia located on Main Street. Their business hours are: Sunday - Thursday: 10 a.m. - 5 p.m. and Friday & Saturday: 10 a.m. - 8 p.m.
